clusters.headline: Death Toll Rises To Six Following Attack On Delta NDC Supporters
aiSummaryBullets: The death toll from the attack on supporters of the NDC in Delta has reached six.
The Inspector-General of Police has initiated an investigation into the incident and officer conduct.

clusters.headline: APC Leaders Across Nigeria Rally Support For President Tinubu
aiSummaryBullets: Senate President Godswill Akpabio and Governor Umo Eno are urging residents in Akwa Ibom to support the president's 2027 re-election bid.
Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin has solicited the backing of religious leaders in Kano, highlighting ongoing federal infrastructure projects.

clusters.headline: Twenty-Four Mourners Die In Southern Ijaw Boat Accident In Bayelsa
aiSummaryBullets: A boat carrying mourners to a funeral overturned in the Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State, resulting in at least 24 confirmed deaths.
President Bola Tinubu and Governor Douye Diri have ordered formal investigations into the cause of the disaster.

clusters.headline: Tinubu seeks Reps’ approval to revise N68.3trn 2026 budget, retains N31.4trn deficit
aiSummaryBullets: Premium Times reports: Tinubu seeks Reps’ approval to revise N68.3trn 2026 budget, retains N31.4trn deficit
Punch reports: Tinubu seeks N3.15tn cut in 2026 budget, retains N31.46tn deficit

Punch reports: Police arrest two robbery suspects in Benue

clusters.headline: Former President Goodluck Jonathan Warns Of Pre-Election Tensions
aiSummaryBullets: Former President Goodluck Jonathan expressed apprehension regarding increasing political intolerance ahead of the 2027 general elections.
Jonathan noted that political groups are increasingly exhibiting behaviors similar to cults to target opponents.

clusters.headline: INEC Confirms Commitment To Court Ruling Regarding ADC Candidacy
aiSummaryBullets: INEC leadership pledged to adhere to court rulings regarding the presidential candidacy of Atiku Abubakar under the African Democratic Congress.
Internal conflicts within the African Democratic Congress have led to protests and claims that the party has struggled to focus on election campaigning.

clusters.headline: Six People Reported Dead Following Attack In Delta State Campaign
aiSummaryBullets: Police report six fatalities and multiple injuries following an attack in Uduere, Ughelli North.
A local curfew has been implemented by authorities while an official investigation into the incident is underway.

clusters.headline: Rotimi Amaechi Claims Buhari Promised 2022 Presidential Ticket
aiSummaryBullets: Rotimi Amaechi stated that he was promised the All Progressives Congress presidential ticket in 2022.
The African Democratic Congress has filed an appeal against a Federal High Court judgment that annulled its leadership.

clusters.headline: President Tinubu Receives Constitutional Amendment For State Police
aiSummaryBullets: President Bola Tinubu has received the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police in the country.
The legislative proposal reached the president after securing unanimous approval from all 36 state Houses of Assembly.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Reinstated As Nvidia CEO Amid Recent Market Rally
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has been officially reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia following an 11-day period of absence.
Company shares rose by 30 percent upon the announcement of his return to the leadership role.

clusters.headline: President Tinubu And First Lady Hold APC Rally In Ibadan Oyo State
aiSummaryBullets: President Bola Tinubu and First Lady Oluremi Tinubu attended an APC presidential campaign rally at Mapo Hall in Ibadan, Oyo State.
The event proceeded with limited fanfare as a mark of respect for the victims of a recent boat accident in Bayelsa.

clusters.headline: Nigeria Democratic Congress Party Calls For Security Consultations
aiSummaryBullets: A senior party member proposed an all-party summit to address rising political violence.
The call follows an incident involving the convoy of vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso in Kano State.

aiSummaryBullets: Premium Times reports: 2027: APC will lose Delta State to NDC – Omo-Agege

clusters.headline: At Least 24 Dead Following Boat Capsize In Southern Nigeria
aiSummaryBullets: A vessel transporting individuals to a funeral service overturned in southern Nigeria.
Authorities confirm at least 24 fatalities resulting from the maritime incident.

clusters.headline: Nigerian Air Force Executes Significant Senior Leadership Reshuffle
aiSummaryBullets: The Nigerian Air Force has initiated a large-scale redeployment of 67 senior officers holding the rank of air vice marshal.
Affected personnel are being moved to new positions at headquarters, operational commands, and various military institutions.

clusters.headline: Nigerian Federal Government Addresses Public Claims and Initiatives
aiSummaryBullets: Officials officially refuted viral claims asserting the existence of 2,000 fake universities and 100 fraudulent professors.
A travel warning was issued for citizens traveling to Ethiopia following 16 reported deaths attributed to high-altitude health issues.

clusters.headline: Peter Obi Urges Vigilance As INEC Announces Mock Accreditation
aiSummaryBullets: Peter Obi encouraged citizens to remain at polling stations after casting their ballots to ensure proper vote counting and transmission.
The Independent National Electoral Commission has designated 598 polling locations in Delta state for upcoming mock accreditation exercises.
